skill.fantasypower.gathering.description: Gain experience by collecting natural resources.
skill.fantasypower.mining.description: Gain experience by mining blocks and ores.
skill.fantasypower.combat.description: Gain experience by defeating hostile mobs.
skill.fantasypower.farming.description: Gain experience by harvesting mature crops.
skill.fantasypower.husbandry.description: Gain experience by breeding and caring for animals.
skill.fantasypower.defense.description: Gain experience from damage that actually removes health.
skill.fantasypower.building.description: Gain experience by placing building blocks.
skill.fantasypower.agility.description: Gain experience by walking, sprinting, and swimming.
skill.fantasypower.magic.description: Gain experience by enchanting and using magical items.
skill.fantasypower.archery.description: Gain experience by defeating hostile mobs with ranged attacks.
ability.fantasypower.associated_ore.desc: Unenchanted pickaxes can produce related bonus ores.
ability.fantasypower.gravel_panning.desc: When gravel would drop flint, it has a 20% chance to replace it with an unlocked metal nugget.
ability.fantasypower.rapid_thrust.descri: Increases attack speed at the cost of attack damage; higher ranks improve the tradeoff.
ability.fantasypower.survivor.descriptio: Reduces damage received from undead creatures.
ability.fantasypower.long_journey.descri: Grants Speed I at extreme altitudes; higher ranks expand the active altitude range.
ability.fantasypower.energetic.descripti: Grants Speed II and Jump Boost I while the sum of food and saturation is high enough.
ability.fantasypower.ambush.description: Deals increased damage to mobs that have not acquired a combat target.
ability.fantasypower.breakthrough.descri: Deals bonus damage to nearly full-health targets and grants brief Speed after taking damage at low health.
ability.fantasypower.weak_point.descript: Builds flaw marks on hit; the threshold hit deals amplified damage, stuns the target, and consumes 1 food point.
ability.fantasypower.counter_sniper.desc: Taking real damage from beyond 8 blocks marks the attacker; your next damaging hit gains bonus damage and consumes the mark.
ability.fantasypower.stealth.description: Become invisible after a period without sound, taking damage, or dealing damage; the next damaging hit is amplified and ends Stealth.
ability.fantasypower.dodge.description: Press the Dodge key to roll in the current movement direction, or backward without directional input, reducing incoming damage briefly.
ability.fantasypower.charged_leap.descri: Hold the Charged Leap key and release it to leap high; an optional Jump-key mode is available in the client config. An airborne hit replaces normal attack damage with skill damage and deals the same damage and stun to every nearby living entity except you, while negating landing damage.
ability.fantasypower.primer.description: Hold Use with a fire charge in the offhand; release after charging to launch a fireball with increased explosion damage.
ability.fantasypower.dangerous_charge.de: Increases explosion damage from firework rockets fired by crossbows without affecting rockets used for elytra boosting.
ability.fantasypower.exhaustion.descript: Instant Damage arrows immediately settle and clear remaining Poison and Wither effects on non-undead targets.
ability.fantasypower.harvest.description: Melee attacks with hoes deal bonus damage based on current food and saturation, at the cost of extra exhaustion.
ability.fantasypower.frugality.descripti: Reduces hunger spent on natural healing and the additional hunger costs of Harvest and Weak Point.
ability.fantasypower.survival_skills.des: Checks once per second and removes harmful effects whose remaining duration is below the current rank threshold.
ability.fantasypower.retaliatory_flame.d: While in fire, soul fire, or lava, ignites nearby enemies; soul fire and lava also deal fire damage. Disabled by Fire Resistance.
ability.fantasypower.well_prepared.descr: Once per game day, prevents death, clears harmful effects, restores health, grants absorption, and provides brief invulnerability.
ability.fantasypower.fine_feed.descripti: Grants Speed III and Jump Boost II to a ridden horse, donkey, or mule whose speed or jump strength is at or below the current rank threshold.
ability.fantasypower.support_aura.descri: Consumes a matching item to heal designated allies within 12 blocks over time; golden apples and carrots also grant absorption to their mounts.
ability.fantasypower.wolf_pack.descripti: When a tamed wolf enters combat, it briefly gains increased damage and a chance to dodge damage, followed by a cooldown.
ability.fantasypower.iron_cavalry.descri: Increases melee damage while riding a horse, donkey, mule, or pig; ridden pigs also inherit a share of your armor.
ability.fantasypower.blast_excavation.de: Use offhand TNT on a block while holding a pickaxe to consume it and create an immediate explosion while reducing its damage to you.
ability.fantasypower.greed.description: Adds 3 blocks of interaction range while holding an unlocked tool type, progressing through axes, shears, hoes, shovels, and pickaxes.
ability.fantasypower.sniffer_treasure.de: When a nearby sniffer completes a digging drop, it may add an item from a configurable curiosity pool.
ability.fantasypower.lucky_cat.descripti: When your tamed cat brings a morning gift, it may add an item from a configurable valuables pool.
ability.fantasypower.chorus_transmutatio: Use a chorus fruit in each hand on a configured block to transmute it; higher alchemy recipes also consume experience levels.
ability.fantasypower.ceiling_wire.descri: Double-tap Jump below a continuous sturdy ceiling to cling or detach; open-air edges block movement and non-solid ceilings detach you. Use offhand pointed dripstone to drop a damaging, stunning spike vertically from its intended placement position.
ability.fantasypower.world_traveler.desc: Sneak-use an empty main hand on a container to bind it; record items in the 36-slot inventory sidebar and matching items picked up from the world route into that container. Inventory and container interactions never trigger routing. Rank two enables cross-dimensional routing.
ability.fantasypower.crushing_blow.descr: Strengthen an iron golem with an anvil; damage builds charge that heals it and crushes nearby enemies.
ability.fantasypower.enchanted_edge.desc: Converts part of melee damage to magic damage; attacks become defense-piercing true damage against low-health targets.
ability.fantasypower.obsidian_reinforcem: Spend 24 obsidian to strengthen an iron golem with recharging shields that block one hit and restore health.
ability.fantasypower.cold_current.descri: Strengthen a snow golem with blue ice; surviving progressively grants attack, health, armor, and final damage bonuses.
